cohort: The study included 32 singleton pregnancies diagnosed with vasa previa (21 type I, 11 type II), compared to a control group with central cord insertion.
finding: Vasa previa type I is associated with slower feto-placental growth due to impaired placental development and biological functions in early pregnancy, whereas VP type II shows no such impact.
birth_weight: Mean birthweight for VP type I was 2493.5 ± 491.6 gr, and for VP type II was 3037.3 ± 400.9 gr.
